__comment__: FINAL TAPE ASSEMBLY: Real PSA tape is adhesive dissolved in solvent (turpentine, ~40% solids) brushed/sprayed onto backing at 20um wet, dried at 80-100C to drive off solvent, wound onto rolls. Peel adhesion comes from viscoelastic Dahlquist criterion: storage modulus <0.3MPa at 1Hz. Our crafting = backing strips + sticky mass + (implicitly) solvent that evaporates. 1 adhesive mass makes ~6 tape rolls (each roll ~10 blocks worth of posting).
